eraDesc: Cognitive revolution. Daily usage of tools. Settlemment beyond Africa
Agricultural Revolution Animals and plants are domesticated, leading to permanent settlements. The Foundation of complex civilisations.
Technology and societal structures continue to improve. Training methodologies mature, giving rise to powerful warriors. The Spartan emmerges.
Technological advancemments in weaponry and military tactics reshape the battleField. Gunpowder is introduced Cannons and muskets revolutionize warFare.
Industrialization brings devastating weapons into the battleField. Guerrialla tactics complicate strategies and evolving technology shapes the era.
Exploration beyond Earth. Satellites, laser, and plasma weapons are pivotal. The space race pushes the boundaries of rocketry and surveillance.
